seo-description: Discover the epic journey of 6b6t - from humble beginnings to becoming one of the most legendary anarchy Minecraft servers. Explore our milestones, community growth, and the stories that shaped our world.
hero-subtitle: A Journey through Time And Chaos
hero-description: From the first block ever placed in the world, to the massive clans and projects that unite thousands of players together. Discover how 6b6t became the biggest anarchy server in the world.
timeline-subtitle: Every great player has a story worth teling
founding-description: 6b6t was born from the vision of creating a true anarchy server where players could build, destroy, and create without limitations. The first seeds of our digital world were planted.
growth-description: As word spread, builders, griefers, and explorers flocked to our world. Great bases were built, epic battles were fought, and legendary players emerged.
expansion-description: Server updates, new features, and a growing community pushed 6b6t to new heights. The world expanded, and so did our legacy.
modern-description: Today, 6b6t stands as a testament to what happens when creativity meets chaos. Our community continues to grow, build, and define what anarchy truly means.
legacy-description: Every block placed, every structure built, every friendship forged - they all contribute to the living history of 6b6t. Join us and become part of the legend.

historyLegacy.theAchievementsDoneOn6b6tWouldnAposTBe: Достижения 6b6t были бы невозможны без замечательных людей, которые каждый день работают над сервером — как из команды администраторов, так и среди игроков.
historyLegacy.theOwnerQbastyAndTheAdminXymbHaveKept: The owner qbasty and the admin Xymb have kept the server online even during the month-long periods of low activity and lack of financial support.
historyLegacy.theIncredibleGrowthWhichAllowed6b6tToRea: The incredible growth which allowed 6b6t to reach hundreds of players online without a queue would not be possible without NeonTonight, ScarX, Tajinlaw and talented developers behind the features of the server.
historyLegacy.numerousTimesInTheServerHistoryClansLike: Numerous times in the server history, clans like LagGang, Colonizadores, 555, THM united hundreds of players together to leave their mark on the server and challenge what is possibe.

historyTimeline.startedByQbastyOnJanuary16th20226b6tImme: Started by qbasty on January 16th, 2022, 6b6t immediately gained traction as the 1.12.2 anarchy server with /tpa and /home.
historyTimeline.duringTheThirdMonthOfItsExistence6b6tAcq: During the third month of its existence, 6b6t acquired 7b7t which was about to shut down. The maps were merged together and history was saved.
historyTimeline.theFirstEverEventDuringWhichTheAntiCheat: The first ever event during which the anti cheat was disabled on 6b6t, allowing for uncontrolled chaos and player activity for over 48 hours.
historyTimeline.text6b6tBecomesTheFirstAnarchyServerToUp: 6b6t becomes the first anarchy server to upgrade to 1.19 thanks to the experimental software MultiPaper. 2b2t took over a year longer to upgrade.
historyTimeline.text6b6tExperiencesTheOnlyPeriodInTimeWh: 6b6t experiences the only period in time when the average player count was around 30. There is no growth without challenges.
historyTimeline.text6b6tUpdatesTo1194ThanksToAnother: 6b6t updates to 1.19.4 thanks to another software called Folia, which brings more stability and performance to the server, resuming the growth.
historyTimeline.theServerReaches300PlayersForTheFirstTim: The server reaches 300+ players for the first time, without any queue, making this a historical achievement for both the marketing efforts of 6b6t and the development team.
historyTimeline.monthLongChristmasEventWithDailyQuestsBr: Month long Christmas event with daily quests, bringing the community together and offering new fun ways to spend time on the server.
historyTimeline.serverUpdatesTo1211OnSeptember13th: Server updates to 1.21.1 on September 13th, 2024, under new software "Abomination" - a major version leap.
historyTimeline.the6b6tTeamForAPeriodOfFewMonths: The 6b6t Team for a period of few months experiments with adding hidden dupes and letting players discover them.
historyTimeline.anotherBuildCompetitionIsHeldOn6b6tLikel: Another build competition is held on 6b6t, likely the most popular. The results are shown in an video on our YouTube channel. Click here to watch the video.
historyTimeline.aRareIllegalsEventTakesPlaceOnTheServer: A rare illegals event takes place on the server, creating a unique experience for those online.
historyTimeline.lastKnownAdminAddedDupeWasPatchedResolvi: Last known admin added dupe was patched, resolving a significant issue.
historyTimeline.newBuildCompetitionInThemeOfAncientCivil: New build competition in theme of Ancient Civilizations was started, encouraging creativity and community participation.
historyTimeline.allTimePlayerRecord6b6tReachesABrandNew: All Time Player Record 6b6t reaches a brand new record of 580 players online at the same time without a queue. The team announces that 6b6t supporting 1000 players online without a queue is soon going to become a reality.
historyTimeline.playersContinueToDevelopExtraordinaryArt: Players continue to develop extraordinary artifacts on the server, such as the largest map art called Ashes by the clan SnifferSquad or the largest spawn logo made by 555.
historyTimeline.theStoryContinuesWhatAreYouGoingToDo: The story continues… what are YOU going to do?
